subject: SF Startup Week — late flight + onsite coverage plan
messages:
From: SF Startup Week <events@startupweek.org>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood booth staffing — speaker late arrival

Hi Karthik,

Quick heads up — one of your session speakers (Maya Srinivasan) had her flight rebooked and is now arriving late on Day 2 (Apr 10, ETA 5:40pm). That means she'll miss the 3:30pm panel and won't be at the booth between 2–5pm as previously planned.

We have some community volunteers but they are briefed only for basic lead capture and swag. Would Redwood be able to provide short coverage for the 2–5pm window and also confirm someone who can step in for the panel at 3:30pm (moderator or backup speaker)?

Attached is the current onsite itinerary and floorplan for quick reference.

Thanks,
Kelly Tran
Events Manager — SF Startup Week
[Attachment: SF_SW_Itinerary_v3.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: K_Tran_Floorplan.png (PNG)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: SF Startup Week <events@startupweek.org>
Date: 2027-04-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood booth staffing — speaker late arrival

Thanks for the alert, Kelly — we'll cover it.

Lauren/Monica/Ben — can one of you take the 2–5pm booth shift on Apr 10 and also be ready to moderate or field-test questions at 3:30pm if needed? The ask is:
- 2:00–5:00pm booth coverage (lead capture + qualifying at-booth demos)
- 3:15pm be at the panel stage (prep with organizer on cue)

If none of you can do the full slot, propose swaps and we can backfill with part-time contractors. I can also move my travel to arrive earlier but would prefer not to change flights unless necessary.

Cc'd Kelly so she knows we're coordinating. Please reply with availability by EOD today.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: flight_change_receipt.png (PNG) — placeholder for booking if we need to switch]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, SF Startup Week <events@startupweek.org>
Date: 2027-04-01T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood booth staffing — speaker late arrival

I can cover 2–4pm on Apr 10. I have a customer call booked at 4:30pm that I can't move, so I can't do the full block. I'm comfortable handling lead capture and basic demos; not ideal as a panel moderator but I can take notes and prep questions for whoever moderates.

If we need someone to be physically at the stage at 3:30pm, I can run over for the panel segment (about 10–12 minutes) and then return to the booth — logistics permitting. Kelly, is the panel on the same level as the booth? Roughly how long is the handoff window?

Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Events Coordinator | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: SF Startup Week <events@startupweek.org>
Date: 2027-04-01T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood booth staffing — speaker late arrival

I can do 2–5pm on Apr 10, happy to cover the full shift and step in for the panel at 3:30pm. Will need a quick briefing on speaking points — Karthik, can you send a 1‑page panel summary?

Also, two routing notes:
- If Maya's flight is fully canceled/changes again, do we want to book a last-minute one-way to ensure she gets in for the evening reception? I can handle rebooking if you send me the travel budget code.
- If Lauren (ha) is covering the booth, can we move Ben's lead-capture tablet to Gate B to avoid the crush around lunch? Ben, can you confirm you can set up at Gate B by 11:30am?

Lauren Bishop
Events Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: SF Startup Week <events@startupweek.org>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T17:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood booth staffing — speaker late arrival — confirmed

Update and confirmation:

- Lauren will cover 2:00–5:00pm and will moderate if needed at 3:30pm. Lauren — thanks for stepping up. Please use the attached 1‑page panel brief (sent privately via Drive link).
- Monica will do 2:00–4:00pm and can run to the panel for the quick segment at 3:30pm if the stage is on the same level. Kelly confirmed the stage is adjacent to the expo floor (2‑minute walk) — Kelly, thanks for the quick reply earlier.
- Ben will set up lead-capture at Gate B by 11:30am and handle midday overflow.
- We will not rebook Maya unless the organizer confirms she absolutely must be present for the evening keynote. If needed, we have a charter contact (Aaron Li at aircharter) who quoted an emergency one-way; holding that option pending approval.

Action items:
- Lauren: pick up panel brief and confirm mic check slot on Apr 10 at 2:45pm.
- Ben: confirm Gate B setup by Apr 7 and send photo of tablet placement.
- Monica: confirm vendor handoff timing (Kelly will provide) so you can run to the stage if needed.
- Karthik: I will be onsite morning of Apr 10 but leaving for another customer meeting at 5:30pm; I will be reachable on mobile for escalation.

Thanks everyone — this looks covered. Kelly, we will keep you in the loop and confirm if any further travel changes are required.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
